page.overview:
Who is Robb Hourne?

Robb Hourne is a playable character of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Brave and Wise King, he is the king of Hourne and father to Machérie and Dario.

Robb Hourne is a UR-rarity unit of the Light element whose main job is Samurai, while his sub jobs are Lancer and Soldier. He can equip the following items: Katana, Helm, Armor, Accessory. His unit cost is 80.

His Master Ability increases his own Critical Hit Rate by 10 and Evasion by 5. His limit burst is Majestic Prestige, which deals Dmg (L) to target after movement to target panel & decreases chance of being targeted.

His Trust Master Reward is the Glinting Armor armor, which bestows HP +482, DEF +10 and the Keen Blade ability, which raises Slash ATK & CT of allies within area around self for 3 turns.
